blocks.text: B-Block — Motion Concepts
Single-SKU offer push. 10% off with code TRYNOVA. Each family built around one product and one specific everyday moment.
BM-01  ·  Sweet Without the Sugar  —  Crunch
Crunch

rows: 15-second motion graphic · 9:16 portrait · static-frame cuts, kinetic typography, no live-action faces.
10% off first Crunch order. Code TRYNOVA.
Women 28–45 NL. Daily yogurt, oats, or coffee drinkers. Sugar-conscious, never on a 'diet'. Refuse to compromise on taste.
Warm, confident female voice. Late 30s tonality. Slightly playful, never preachy. Like recommending something to a friend.
Bright, modern, sparse — single repeating piano motif with a soft bass kick. No drops, no swells.

blocks.text: Sweet · without sugar. The everyday-moment angle: yogurt, coffee, smoothie — Crunch upgrades all of them with one scoop.
3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows: “This yoghurt has no taste of guilt!”
“I stopped buying sweeteners the day I tried this.”

blocks.text: Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

rows: Hand spooning Crunch over plain yogurt. Slow motion, golden light. Hook text burns on screen.
“[ Hook · pick A, B, or C ]”
Cut to iced coffee with Crunch stirring in. Brown swirl in cream.
Smoothie pour, vibrant colour. Quick whip-pan to product hero.
“One scoop of Crunch — and they all taste better.”
Product on light surface. Numbers animate in clean type.
“Six calories per scoop. As sweet as fifty grams of sugar.”
Wide shot — yogurt bowl, smoothie, coffee all in frame.
“No aftertaste. Nothing to feel bad about.”
Product hero. Code animates in. CTA button visible.
“Try it now for ten percent off with code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: Logo + product + CODE TRYNOVA — SHOP NOW. Hold 1 second.
BM-02  ·  Eight Litres. Zero Sugar.  —  Hydra
Hydra

rows: 15-second motion graphic · 9:16 portrait · liquid motion graphics, splash transitions, kinetic typography.
10% off first Hydra order. Code TRYNOVA.
Women 25–40 NL. Multi-drink-per-day — ice tea, juice, soft drinks. Sugar-aware but loyal to flavour. The 'why am I still drinking this' moment.
Bright, direct female voice. Early 30s. Crisper than Crunch scripts — slightly more energetic, never shouty. Like a smart friend ordering for you.
Light percussion, hi-hats, water-drop FX. Single sustained synth pad. 110 BPM, never aggressive.

blocks.text: Volume math is the dopamine spike. One bottle = eight litres. Zero of everything else. Direct trade against the daily ice-tea habit.
3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows: “One little bottle. Eight litres of flavour. Zero sugar.”
“This little bottle replaced an entire fridge full of ice tea.”
“The bottle that quietly ended my soft-drink habit.”

blocks.text: Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

rows: Glass of plain water on a counter. Hook text appears.
“[ Hook · pick A, B, or C ]”
Pour-in of Hydra concentrate — colour blooms instantly through the water.
Three flavour glasses splash into frame, one per second.
“And without that quiet 'why am I still drinking this' feeling.”
Bottle hero. Animated math: 1 bottle → 8 LITRES with liquid morph.
“One bottle of Hydra makes eight litres — two weeks of flavour for the price of one fizzy drink.”
Friends clinking glasses, fast cut. Warm casual moment.
Bottle hero. Code animates in. CTA button.
“Try it for ten percent off with code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: Bottle + CODE TRYNOVA — SHOP NOW. Hold 1 second.
SK-Block — Motion Concepts
Cold-audience Starter Box acquisition. 30% off with code TRYNOVA. Two entry hypotheses: permission and protein gap.
SKM-01  ·  Welcome to NOVA  —  Starter Box
Starter Box · Permission

rows: 20-second motion graphic · 9:16 portrait · product-led cuts, kinetic typography, warm lighting throughout.
30% off first Starter Box. Code TRYNOVA.
Women 30–45 NL. Cold to brand. Tried clean eating, tired of being told what not to eat. Want indulgence that quietly works for them.
Warm, intimate, slightly conspiratorial female voice. Late 30s. Reads like a friend leaning in. No salesman lift on the offer line.
Soft piano melody, builds gently over 15 seconds, releases on the kit reveal. 80 BPM. Quiet whoosh on each product cut.

blocks.text: Three felt moments of permission. Each one a complete sentence. No question marks. Reveal the kit only after the audience has nodded three times.
3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows: “Imagine your morning yogurt tasting like dessert.”
“Everything you'd normally feel guilty about — only made to actually work for you.”
“This is the box that quietly changed how I eat.”

blocks.text: Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

rows: Close-up: hand stirring Crunch into yogurt. Chocolate swirl. Hook text on screen.
“[ Hook · pick A, B, or C ]”
Cut to iced coffee being shaken. Stat overlay: 19G PROTEIN.
“Your daily iced coffee — with nineteen grams of protein.”
Hand opening a Protein Bites pack. Bite-shot. Light catches the chocolate finish.
Pull back to full Starter Box reveal on warm-lit table.
Top-down kit. Products animate in subtly with one stat tag each.
“The NOVA Starter Box. All the food you already love, finally made to work for you.”
Kit hero. 30% OFF badge animates in. CTA. Code prominent.
“Get thirty percent off your first kit, with code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: Kit hero + 30% OFF + CODE TRYNOVA — SHOP NOW. Hold 2 seconds.
SKM-02  ·  The Protein Gap  —  Starter Box
Starter Box · Protein Gap

rows: 20-second motion graphic · 9:16 portrait · counter-led animation, kinetic typography, mid-energy edit.
30% off first Starter Box. Code TRYNOVA.
Women 25–44 NL. Cold to brand. Curious about protein but allergic to 'gym-bro' branding. Want substance without the protein-bar aesthetic.
Steady, intelligent, lightly playful female voice. Mid 30s. Reads facts with confidence — never lectures, never pitches.
Mid-tempo electronic, light rhythmic pulse. Bass-led but soft. Builds slightly into the kit reveal. Subtle 'tick' on each protein number.

blocks.text: Open with the gap. Not the problem — the gap. Neutral, specific, quantified. Kit fills it. Numbers do the convincing.
3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows: “Most women miss their daily protein target by 50 grams!”
“The difference between 'eating clean' and 'eating enough protein' is bigger than you think.”
“How much protein do you actually eat? Most women overestimate by forty percent.”

blocks.text: Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

rows: Plate of regular food. Counter overlay rolls: protein consumed vs daily need. 50g gap visualised.
“[ Hook · pick A, B, or C ]”
Counter resets. Cut to woman in soft daylight, light shrug.
Three product reveals: coffee, snack, sahne. Each protein number floats up with a tick sound.
“Real food, real protein and real flavour rarely come in the same package.”
Beat of silence on dark frame. Then: kit appears with a single line of light.
Top-down kit in warm lighting. Quick product cuts with their numbers.
“Nineteen grams in your coffee. Fourteen in your snack. Forty-three in your topping.”
Kit hero. 30% OFF badge animates in. CTA.
“Get thirty percent off your first kit, with code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: Kit + 30% OFF + CODE TRYNOVA — SHOP NOW. Hold 2 seconds.
